description: A sequencer that walks a binary tree of nodes, one node per clock, taking a branch at random wherever a node has two children

params.text: Chooses Step, where each clock takes a branch at random as it arrives, or Sequence, where a whole path is chosen in advance and the clock walks along it
Turns the sequence round at the end of a path so it walks back towards the root, in place of jumping straight to it
Shifts the chance at every node in the tree, -1 to +1; turned up the second branch becomes more likely, turned down the first branch does
Stops the gate and the clock stepping the sequence, so the active node keeps sending

inputs.text: In Step trigger type this steps the sequence in the same way the clock does; in Sequence trigger type it picks a fresh path through the whole tree and starts it at the root
Moves to the next node on each rising edge, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Returns to the root node on a rising edge, and the clock is ignored for 1ms afterwards
Adds to the CHANCE MOD knob, 1V covering half of its travel
Flips the HOLD button on each rising edge
Flips the TRIG TYPE button on each rising edge
Flips the BOUNCE button on each rising edge

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V while the active node carries this jack's number
The active node's number as a pitch, one twelfth of a volt per number, so node 1 gives 0V and node 13 gives 1V
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time a path through the tree finishes

notes: left-click a node square on the screen for a menu that sets its output number and its chance, previews it, adds a child, removes it, or generates a tree below it
drag the screen to move around the tree and scroll on it to zoom; the three buttons under the screen follow the active node, undo an edit and redo it, and none can be clicked for help
a node whose number falls outside 1 to 8 fires none of the eight jacks, though its pitch reaches VOCT OUT
a new Treequencer holds a root node and two children, so it sequences from the moment a clock is patched
menu: Reset Screen Position — returns the tree view to the zoom and position it starts at
Toggle Follow Nodes — keeps the view centred on the node the sequence is on
Default Scale — sets the scale a note is drawn from when Add Child makes a new node
Note Representation: Squares, Letters, Numbers — draws a node's number as a block of dots, as a note name with its octave, or as a number; Letters also relabels the eight output jacks
Screen Color Mode: Light, Vibrant, Muted, Greyscale — sets the palette the node squares are drawn in
